description: A load bank in the standalone demo rack, behind one of its meters. It steps through a demonstration duty cycle so the meter in front of it has something to measure. A load behind a branch circuit monitor is split over the monitor's circuits, each with its own share and cycle.

trip.description: The load bank's own protection trips it off until reset.

name: Demo rack load bank

design_power.description: Full power of the load bank.

power_factor.description: Power factor of the load bank.

cycle.description: Spacing of the steps of the demonstration duty cycle.

min_fraction.description: Lowest share of full power the duty cycle reaches.

power_in.description: Feed from the demo rack meter in front of it.
